definition: A process unit's throughput as a share of its constrained capacity, for one refinery.
grain: hourly and daily, by unit and refinery
basis: unit throughput (bbl/d) / constrained unit capacity (bbl/d), averaged over the period
not_note: Not crude utilization: it covers every unit, not only the crude unit, and uses constrained capacity.

definition: Fresh crude charged to the crude units as a share of crude capacity, for one refinery and month.
basis: crude throughput (bbl/d) / constrained crude capacity (bbl/d); MPC divides by average calendar-day capacity
not_note: Not MPC's published figure, which is company-wide and uses average calendar-day capacity.

definition: The submitted mid-term plan for a month compared with the same month's average over prior years, by product (crude, gasoline, diesel, jet).
basis: plan volume against the same-month average of 2 to 5 prior years

definition: Distillate produced (ULSD, kerosene, jet) as a share of crude and feed charged.
grain: daily and month to date, by refinery
basis: distillate production (bbl) / total crude and feed charged (bbl) x 100
not_note: Not distillate sales: it counts production.

definition: Gasoline produced (finished and blendstock) as a share of crude and feed charged.
grain: daily and month to date, by refinery
basis: gasoline production (bbl) / total crude and feed charged (bbl) x 100
not_note: Not gasoline sales: it counts production.

definition: The volume of swing streams and where they are routed, as they shift distillate and gasoline make.
grain: daily and month to date, by refinery
basis: volume (bbl) by stream and routing; calculation not yet set

definition: Total clean product output by refinery over the plan horizon.
grain: daily and month to date, by refinery
not_note: Not a yield: it is a volume.

definition: Each NGL product's balance at the refinery (opening, production, consumption, transfers) compared with planned purchases and make.
grain: daily and month to date, by refinery and NGL product
basis: ending balance = opening + production - consumption +/- transfers

definition: Pipeline throughput as a share of pipeline capacity, by distribution node and material.
grain: daily and month to date, by pipeline segment, node and material
not_note: Not pipeline throughput, which MPC and MPLX publish: it is a share of capacity.

definition: Volume moved by barge and vessel as a share of available marine capacity.
grain: daily and month to date, by node and material
basis: volume moved by marine (bbl) / available marine capacity (bbl) x 100

definition: Total product moved between regions on named segments, by product and mode.
grain: daily and month to date, by segment, product and mode
basis: volume transferred between regions (bbl) per period

definition: Actual sales less forecast sales for the period, against the plan version named.
grain: daily and month to date, by product and region
not_note: Not forecast accuracy over many periods, which would be a separate measure.

definition: Actual purchases less forecast purchases for the period, against the plan version named.
grain: daily and month to date, by product and region

definition: Actual opening inventory against the planned opening level for the next month.
basis: actual opening inventory (bbl) against planned opening inventory (bbl)

definition: An alert raised when a distribution-plan input table changes by more than a set share from the week before.
A summary of the largest plan changes and the economic drivers behind them.
A screen of each crude's breakeven value from the planning model against its delivered price, by refinery, to pick incremental barrels for a full evaluation.
not_note: Not a measure of how well crude was bought: that is margin capture or a backcast.

definition: Benchmark crack spreads: the market value of products made from a set ratio of crude, less the crude's price.
basis: products price - crude price, for a stated crude:product ratio (for example 3-2-1)
not_note: Not realized refinery margin, not margin capture, and not MPC's R&M Margin Indicator. A 3-2-1 built from separate product and crude legs is not the published series.

definition: Benchmark gasoline spot prices at named hubs.
Benchmark distillate and jet spot prices at named hubs.
Crude oil benchmark prices and differentials, with related futures (natural gas, heating oil, RBOB).
The difference between two chosen market markers over time.
Further benchmark, crude, renewables and NGL prices used in planning.
A list of turnaround activities planned for the next four months, by refinery.
not_note: Not a turnaround optimization: it tracks the activities already planned.

definition: A trend of rack sales and purchase statuses from marketing, showing statuses held for more than a week.
A notification when a refinery sets a new clean products production rate record.
Open capital project evaluations against their due dates.
Mid-term plan submissions against their due dates.
Critical planning activities and meetings against their due dates.
Marketing's results against the marketing plan.
A future view of plant status across the region, combining operations notes with unit performance.
A future capability for ad hoc trends of plan data and a chatbot over the planning database.
MPC's Refining & Marketing margin (sales revenue less the cost of refinery inputs and purchased products) per barrel of net refinery throughput.
grain: quarterly and annual, company and region
basis: R&M margin ($) / net refinery throughput (bbl); from 2026 the margin includes impacts from derivative activity
aliases: R&M margin per barrel;refining margin per barrel
not_note: Not a crack spread: it is realized, not a market benchmark.

definition: Reported R&M margin as a share of the R&M Margin Indicator: how much of the benchmark margin was realized.
not_note: Not the crack spread and not the indicator: it is the ratio of realized margin to the indicator.

definition: MPC's hypothetical R&M margin built from market data and operational guidance, posted monthly.
Refining operating costs, excluding planned turnaround and depreciation and amortization, per barrel of throughput.
grain: quarterly and annual, company (net throughput) and region (gross throughput)
not_note: Excludes planned turnaround costs, which have their own measure.

definition: Distribution costs, excluding depreciation and amortization, per barrel of net refinery throughput; mostly long-term agreements with MPLX.
not_note: Not a contract tariff: a disclosed aggregate cost per barrel.

definition: Planned turnaround and major maintenance costs, expensed as incurred, per barrel of net refinery throughput.
grain: quarterly and annual, company and region
not_note: Not an annualized turnaround cost: MPC expenses turnarounds when incurred, so the figure rises in heavy turnaround years.

definition: The margin given up because of planned turnaround downtime.
grain: per turnaround and annual, by refinery
basis: margin of the throughput lost to planned downtime ($)

definition: MPC's Refining EBITDA per barrel of total throughput for each region, ranked against the same regions of Phillips 66 and Valero.
basis: regional Refining EBITDA ($) / total throughput (bbl), ranked
not_note: Not R&M margin per barrel: it is built on Refining EBITDA.

definition: MPC's annual cash bonus Adjusted EBITDA per barrel of total throughput, as a percentile against a peer group.
basis: ACB Adjusted EBITDA ($) / total throughput (bbl), percentile
